recent_lines: The route was supposed to be flat. I believed it.
I own four bikes. I ride one. The others are optimised.
My kit is perfectly colour-matched. My fitness is not.
Peaked in September. It's April. I'm "building back.
The climb looked manageable on Komoot. It was not manageable.
Garmin says 4 watts above target. I negotiate with myself for 6km.
Café stop planned for km 40. I'm at km 41 and still riding.
Why do I always bonk on the one ride I didn't bring a second bar?
Third ride this week. Legs fine. Morale is the problem.
Nobody told me "just a social ride" meant 38 km/h average.
My riding buddy "just sits on" at 42 km/h.
The group ride finishes. Everyone "wasn't even trying.
I own four bikes. I ride one. The others are "for different conditions.
My kit matches. My fitness does not.
My Garmin has seen things I'm not ready to discuss with my coach.
